title: specloop config
description: Configuration for the specloop validator (.specloop.json at the project root).

specDir.description: Directory holding the spec files, relative to the project root.

phasePattern.description: Regex a filename must match to be treated as a numbered phase file.

requiredProcessFiles.description: Files that must exist inside specDir.

requireGoalLine.description: Require a 'Goal:' line in every phase file.

requireDependsOnLine.description: Require a 'Depends on:' line in every phase file.

enforceIndexCounts.description: Cross-check the index phase-table progress/status against the phase files.

agentsFile.description: Root instructions file that must reference the reporting standard.
